description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is an early-stage AI security startup building tools to help companies keep AI products safe, secure, and trustworthy. The Full Stack Engineer will build and ship product features across the TypeScript and Node.js backend, PostgreSQL data layer, cloud deployment, and React web application. The role also contributes to product decisions, engineering practices, and security-focused software quality.
Full-stack TypeScript engineer building React applications, PostgreSQL data layers, cloud deployments, and automated tests

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship full-stack features using TypeScript across the API, database, and web application
• Design, develop, and maintain PostgreSQL schemas and the data layer that supports the product
• Create clean, responsive, and efficient user interfaces using React
• Deploy applications to a modern cloud environment and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines
• Write automated tests to support fast development while protecting product quality and reliability
• Take ownership of features from initial implementation through production deployment
• Contribute to product decisions and help establish engineering practices as an early member of the team
• Consider security risks throughout development and build software with a focus on safety and reliability

Requirements:
• Demonstrable ability to build and deliver software, supported by a portfolio, GitHub projects, shipped side projects, open-source contributions, CTF experience, or other evidence of practical work
• Strong working knowledge of TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js, along with solid software engineering fundamentals
• Experience working with REST APIs, relational databases, PostgreSQL, SQL, and data modeling
• Front-end development skills with React
• A security-conscious approach to software development, including the ability to identify potential risks and test for them
• Ability to work independently, make technical decisions, and take responsibility for delivering features without relying on a closely managed backlog
• No specific degree or minimum years of professional experience are required. Practical skills and demonstrated ability to build are the priority

Preferred:
• familiarity with Next.js is preferred
• Interest in or experience with AI and large language model (LLM) applications
• Background in cybersecurity or application security
• Experience with cloud platforms, serverless technologies, or CI/CD pipelines
• A track record of shipping a project end to end, with work that can be demonstrated
